_comment: Day 2 topology-builder tolerances and rules. Committed so every snap/merge is reproducible. Change only with a dated note in builder/CHANGELOG.md.
circuits_rule: circuits tag; else cables/3 (floor, min 1); else 1. Multi-voltage ways: circuits split evenly across voltages (min 1 each).

dangling_snap._comment: Day 4. Applied only to way ends that are not inside a station/plant, not shared, and with no station within nearest_station_m.

ke_region._comment: Day 4 working definition of the K-Electric network [VERIFY]: buses at <= max_kv inside the Karachi-Hub-Gharo service box, excluding stations whose operator says NTDC/NGC/WAPDA. Checked against PER KE counts (1x500, 12x220, 62x132, 3x66 kV).
ke_region.lon_note: East edge moved from 67.85 to 67.70 on Day 4. At 67.85 the box cut through the Gharo-Jhimpir wind corridor, so wind-farm 132 kV yards (S0331/S0333/S0338/S0339/S0572/S0648, 67.82-68.01 E) were reported as KE interface points.

pss_line_check._comment: Day 5, fixed before the first run (16 Nov 2026). Cross-check of PSS 44th line rows (data to June 2019) against the scored build. Geometry flags and pair checks are reported only; circuit corrections follow correct_rule and go to builder/circuit_overrides.csv.
pss_line_check.too_far_note: flag a matched pair if the straight-line distance exceeds 1.10 x the PSS route km (a route can't be shorter than the straight line)
pss_line_check.too_close_note: flag if the PSS route km exceeds 2 x straight-line + 10 km
pss_line_check.correct_rule: Change an OSM circuit count only when all hold: every PSS row for the endpoint pair is fully double-circuit (single-circuit route 0, double-circuit route > 0, two circuits in the row); the shortest OSM path at that voltage is within corridor_tolerance of the PSS route km; and the hop is a single OSM branch whose count is the untagged default (default1). Then set that branch's ways to 2 circuits. Applied once; S4 recomputed once afterwards.

scored_mode_note: Decided by Furqan on 16 Nov 2026: the explicit-voltage-tags build (osm/build/explicit) is the scored model; the inferred build is reported only as a sensitivity case.
plant_terminal_rule: Day 3: a plant polygon is a terminal only for way END nodes or nodes shared by >=2 ways; lines merely crossing a plant polygon are not split there.
inference_station_rules_use: station tag_kvs + voltages of incident lines with a TAGGED voltage (Day 3). Day 2 also counted inferred line voltages, which let inferences cascade; tag_kvs-only (tried Day 3) left 3,204 km unknown because only 27% of substations carry a voltage tag.

station_name_hints._comment: Used only for naming/backbone/S3 reporting, never for topology. Keyed by OSM element id of a station member. Each needs confirmation [VERIFY].
